description: This file contains integration tests for the PolicyPersistenceOperationsActor in the Eclipse Ditto policies persistence module. It tests CRUD operations such as purging namespaces, retrieving policies, and creating policies by invoking actor methods and checking responses.

classes.name: PolicyPersistenceOperationsActorIT
classes.description: Integration test class for PolicyPersistenceOperationsActor, extending MongoEventSourceITAssertions to test policy persistence operations.

methods.name: purgeNamespaceWithoutSuffix
methods.description: Test method to verify namespace purge operation without suffix.

methods.name: purgeEntitiesWithNamespace
methods.description: Test method to verify purging entities within a namespace.

methods.name: getServiceName
methods.description: Returns the name of the service, 'policies'.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the resource type, corresponding to Policy command resource type.

methods.name: toEntityId
methods.description: Converts an EntityId object to a PolicyId.

methods.name: getCreateEntityCommand
methods.description: Builds and returns a command to create a new Policy entity.

methods.name: getCreateEntityResponseClass
methods.description: Returns the class type for create policy response.

methods.name: getRetrieveEntityCommand
methods.description: Builds and returns a command to retrieve a Policy entity.

methods.name: getRetrieveEntityResponseClass
methods.description: Returns the class type for retrieve policy response.

methods.name: getEntityNotAccessibleClass
methods.description: Returns the exception class indicating a policy entity is not accessible.

methods.name: startActorUnderTest
methods.description: Initializes and starts the Actor under test with the provided ActorSystem and configuration.

methods.name: startEntityActor
methods.description: Starts an actor that represents a Policy entity with the specified PolicyId.
